name: Palo Alto Networks

logo.source: commons.wikimedia.org - Wikipedia infobox logo file: PaloAltoNetworks 2020 Logo.svg

description: Palo Alto Networks sells enterprise cybersecurity. Customers buy firewalls (hardware and virtual), cloud-delivered security subscriptions on top of them, a cloud-based secure-access service (Prisma Access), security-operations software (Cortex) and, since February 2026, identity security through the CyberArk acquisition; Chronosphere (bought January 2026) adds an observability product. About 80 percent of revenue is subscription and support, recognised over contract terms of one to five years; the remaining 20 percent is up-front product revenue from firewalls and software licences. The company pushes customers to consolidate many point products onto its platforms (it calls this platformization). Hardware is built by outside manufacturers, mainly Flex.

gics.note: Conventional label as listed in the Wikipedia 'List of S&P 500 companies' table (GICS sector and GICS sub-industry columns). That table does not give the industry group or industry levels, so they are null rather than filled from memory.

hq.note: FY2026 10-K: incorporated in 2005, headquartered in Santa Clara; HQ lease about 941,000 sq ft

employees.note: Headcount rose from 16,068 to 21,921 during fiscal 2026 (FY2026 10-K risk factor); includes staff added with CyberArk and Chronosphere

businessLines.name: Subscription and support
businessLines.how: Customers prepay multi-year (typically one to five year) subscriptions and support contracts attached to firewalls or sold standalone as cloud services; revenue is recognised evenly over the term, so renewals and attach rate drive it.
businessLines.description: Security subscriptions (threat prevention, SASE, cloud and security-operations services) plus support and maintenance.

businessLines.name: Product
businessLines.how: One-time sale of a firewall appliance or software licence, recognised when delivered; it creates the base on which the recurring subscriptions are sold.
businessLines.description: Hardware firewalls (ML-Powered NGFW) and software licences (VM-Series, SD-WAN, Panorama, on-premise CyberArk identity licences).
